================================================================================
cppo directives between structure items and match arms
================================================================================

#ifdef STRINGLIT
let has_stringlit = true
#endif
let typeof js = match js with
  | `Floatlit _ -> "floatlit"
#ifdef STRINGLIT
  | `Stringlit _ -> "stringlit"
#endif

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (cppo_directive)
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (boolean)))
  (cppo_directive)
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (parameter
        (value_pattern))
      (match_expression
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (any_pattern))
          (string
            (string_content)))
        (cppo_directive)
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (any_pattern))
          (string
            (string_content)))
        (cppo_directive)))))

================================================================================
camlp4 conditional section as a let body
================================================================================

let to_string =
  #<If:TESTING>
    original_name
  #<Else>
    function
    | FakeSource n -> n
    | Source n -> n
  #<End>
let y = 2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (camlp4_conditional
        (camlp4_directive)
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (camlp4_directive)
        (function_expression
          (match_case
            (constructor_pattern
              (constructor_path
                (constructor_name))
              (value_pattern))
            (value_path
              (value_name)))
          (match_case
            (constructor_pattern
              (constructor_path
                (constructor_name))
              (value_pattern))
            (value_path
              (value_name))))
        (camlp4_end_directive))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))

================================================================================
opa bypass directive and quotation at structure level
================================================================================

##register myfunction : string -> string
#<< type data = string >>#;
let x = 1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (opa_directive)
  (opa_quotation)
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))
